instruction.name: vreplve.h
instruction.description: Repeat the element in lane `idx` (index modulo 8) of `a` to fill whole vector.

latencies.notes: Latency from the inserted or index register to the vector destination. A chain that depends only on vd (vreplve.h $vr0, … writing $vr0 which it also reads) measures 1 cycle because the self-dependency is handled by renaming, so the latency is measured as a round trip through vpickve2gr.h (5.96 cycles) with the 3-cycle pick subtracted, which leaves 3.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vreplve.h $vr0, $vr8, $r4; vreplve.h $vr1, $vr9, $r5; vreplve.h $vr2, $vr10, $r6; vreplve.h $vr3, $vr11, $r7; vreplve.h $vr4, $vr12, $r8; vreplve.h $vr5, $vr13, $r9; vreplve.h $vr6, $vr14, $r10; vreplve.h $vr7, $vr15, $r11
